basic_details.short_information: THDC India Limited (a Schedule "A" Mini Ratna Government PSU) is engaging 01 Associate (Retired Executive) for VPHEP, Pipalkoti, from PSUs/Govt. organization retirees. Applications in the prescribed format must be mailed to [email protected] on or before 21 November 2026. The consolidated compensation is Rs. 105,000 per month.

qualification.details: Essential qualification: AMIE or Full-Time/Part-Time B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a recognized University / Institution approved by AICTE. Experience: the applicant should have retired from E-8 level or above (IDA Pay Scale 1,20,000 – 3% – 2,80.000/- as printed). Experience: minimum 15 years of experience in Civil work related to the construction of Hydro Power Projects in CPSU/State PSUs. Age limit: not more than 64 years as on 06.11.2026. Compensation: consolidated monthly compensation/honorarium of Rs. 105,000/- per month. Other benefits, namely Conveyance, Mobile charges reimbursement, HRA, Leaves etc., shall be as per the THDCIL Associate Scheme. Term: THDCIL is looking to engage Associates for a period of one year, which can be extended up to 2 years on mutual consent. | The notice prints no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details.

important_instructions: Offer of appointment, salary slips, ID proof or any other document shall not be considered as an experience certificate. The notice advises applicants to check the Career Section of the THDC website regularly for updates. Any false, incorrect or suppressed information found at any stage makes the applicant liable to be terminated from the engagement forthwith, without prejudice to other legal and disciplinary action, as stated in the declaration on the form.

content_sections.heading: About THDC
content_sections.text: THDC India Limited is a Public-Sector Enterprise registered as a Public Limited Company in July 1988 under the Companies Act, 1956. Its equity is shared between NTPC Limited and the Government of UP in the ratio 74.496:25.504. The company works across Hydro, Thermal, Wind, Solar and Coal Mining domains, and its flagship plant is the Tehri Hydro Power Plant (1000 MW).

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application form in the prescribed format enclosed with the notice by email to [email protected] on or before 21.11.2026. The notice states that no application will be entertained after the last day. The notice does not give an email subject line or a postal address.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: AMIE or Full-Time/Part-Time B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a recognized University / Institution approved by AICTE. Experience: the applicant should have retired from E-8 level or above (IDA Pay Scale 1,20,000 – 3% – 2,80.000/- as printed). Experience: minimum 15 years of experience in Civil work related to the construction of Hydro Power Projects in CPSU/State PSUs. Age limit: not more than 64 years as on 06.11.2026. Compensation: consolidated monthly compensation/honorarium of Rs. 105,000/- per month. Other benefits, namely Conveyance, Mobile charges reimbursement, HRA, Leaves etc., shall be as per the THDCIL Associate Scheme. Term: THDCIL is looking to engage Associates for a period of one year, which can be extended up to 2 years on mutual consent. The notice prints no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The notice advises candidates to bring self-attested documents in the sequence below, with the originals for verification, and to share the same at the given email address. Proof of date of birth (Class Xth Marksheet/Pass certificate, or Date of Birth Certificate if the Class Xth document does not mention it). Marksheet and Pass Certificate of Class Xth. Marksheet and Pass Certificate of Class XIIth. Marksheet (all semesters/years) of the Essential Qualification. Degree of the Essential Qualification. Marksheet and Degree of Additional Qualification (if any). Experience Certificate of the present and all organizations, clearly mentioning the period of service, designation, department and functional area. Conversion certificate of Grade/CGPA/OGPA to percentage of marks from the University/Institute (if applicable). Valid Photo ID (Aadhar Card, Voter Card etc.). Caste / category certificate SC/ST/PwBDs or latest OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate from the Competent Authority in the prescribed Government of India format (format enclosed).

faq.question: Q1. How many Associate (Retired Executive) posts is THDC filling?
faq.answer: THDC is engaging 01 Associate (Retired Executive) for VPHEP, Pipalkoti, from PSUs/Govt. organization retirees.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for THDC Associate (Retired Executive)?
faq.answer: The application must be mailed on or before 21.11.2026. The notice says no application will be entertained after the last day.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for THDC Associate (Retired Executive)?
faq.answer: AMIE or Full-Time/Part-Time B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a recognized University / Institution approved by AICTE.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for THDC Associate (Retired Executive)?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not more than 64 years as on 06.11.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of THDC Associate (Retired Executive)?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly compensation/honorarium is Rs. 105,000/- per month. Conveyance, mobile charges reimbursement, HRA, leaves etc. are as per the THDCIL Associate Scheme.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for THDC Associate (Retired Executive)?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed application format and mail it to [email protected] on or before 21.11.2026, with the self-attested documents the notice lists.

faq.question: Q7. Who can apply as a retired executive?
faq.answer: The applicant should have retired from E-8 level or above and have minimum 15 years of experience in Civil work related to the construction of Hydro Power Projects in CPSU/State PSUs.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the Associate engagement?
faq.answer: The engagement is for one year, which can be extended up to 2 years on mutual consent.

faq.question: Q9. Is the Rs. 105,000 pay a fixed amount?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice calls it consolidated monthly compensation/honorarium of Rs. 105,000/- per month. Other benefits are as per the THDCIL Associate Scheme.
